title: Tsu Sau Ching

page_data.en:

343
Date 24/5/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

May 24th 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that the rebels have been paying their men only six cents per day since Chen Chi Lei 陳其美 was assassinated. The rank and file being dissatisfied with this, created a disturbance on the evening of 23rd instant in Wung Tuh Li 文德里 alleyway, Frenchtown but they dispersed after some persuasion on the part of the leaders.
With reference to the reported arrest of an officer and ten men at the Arsenal for selling bombs to the rebels, the men have been released and discharged from the Arsenal Works. The officer, whose name is Tsu Sau Ching 周□□ is still detained.
It is reported that the family of Chen Chi Lei intend to remove his coffin to the Huchow Guild.
The delegates of the seventeen provinces who came to Nanking at the request of General Feng Kou Chang and who are now, for the time being, dispersed, are agreed as to the inadvisability of changing the President until such time as a Parliament can be convoked.
The conference at Nanking has been adjourned but will resume its sittings when representatives of the provinces which have declared independence are expected to attend. They will be invited to do so.

Your Obedient Servant,

（签名）

Chief Detective Inspector.

（批：K.P. 24/5.
am）

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（手写批注：Received 111 / May '24）

343
日期 16/5/24

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

1916年5月24日。

先生，
据报，自陈其美遇刺以来，叛军每日仅向其部下支付六分钱。普通士兵对此不满，于本月23日晚在法租界文德里弄堂制造骚乱，经领导人劝说后散去。
关于兵工厂一名警官及十名士兵因向叛军出售炸弹而被捕的报道，这些士兵已被释放并解除在兵工厂的职务。该警官名为周□□（Tsu Sau Ching），目前仍被拘留。
据报，陈其美家属拟将其灵柩移至湖州会馆。
应冯国璋将军之邀前来南京的十七省代表，目前暂时离散，他们一致同意在国会召开之前不宜更换总统。
南京会议已休会，但预计当宣布独立的各省代表出席时，会议将复会。届时将邀请他们参加。

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）

总探长。

（批：K.P. 5月24日。
上午）

警务处总监。

（手写批注：1924年5月 / 111号收讫）
